eventDetail.scope: HONET has been phenomenal in attracting quality research papers from around the world. The conference has been successful, gradually emerging as a focal point for research that targets local and global issues related to science and technology. The 23rd International Conference IEEE HONET 2026 maintains a focus on R&D and the use of information & communication technology for Smart Cities and Communities. Specifically, the role of IoT, Robotics and AI, data analytics, and energy & autonomous transportation in conjunction with ICT, e-Healthcare & role of Photonics, renewable energy will be explored in the technical sessions. As per previous IEEE HONET events, we are expecting papers in above mentioned. Also, forums on Higher Edu Skills & Smart-Cities, workshops, tutorials and students' poster sessions will be included. IEEE HONET 2023 will be hosted Cyprus Int'l University, Nicosia, N. Cyprus
